title: Training Language Models via Neural Cellular Automata
abstract: arXiv:2603.10055v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pre-training is crucial for large language models (LLMs), as it is when most representations and capabilities are acquired. However, natural language pre-training has problems: high-quality text is finite, contains human biases, and entangles knowledge with reasoning. This raises a fundamental question: is natural language the only path to intelligence? We propose using neural cellular automata (NCA) to generate synthetic, non-linguistic data for pre-pre-training LLMs--training on synthetic-then-natural language. NCA data exhibits rich spatiotemporal structure and statistics resembling natural language while being controllable and cheap to generate at scale. We find that pre-pre-training on only 164M NCA tokens improves downstream language modeling by up to 6% and accelerates convergence by up to 1.6x in 400M-3B models trained with Chinchilla optimal data budgets. translated_title: 基于神经元胞自动机训练语言模型
translated_abstract: 预训练对大语言模型至关重要，因为大部分表示与能力都是在这一阶段习得的。然而，自然语言预训练存在问题：高质量文本是有限的，包含人类偏见，并且将知识与推理纠缠在一起。这引发了一个根本性问题：自然语言是通往智能的唯一途径吗？我们提出使用神经元胞自动机（NCA）生成合成的、非语言的数据来对大语言模型进行预前训练——即先在合成数据、再在自然语言上训练。NCA 数据具有丰富的时空结构和类似自然语言的统计特性，同时可控且能廉价地大规模生成。我们发现，仅使用 1.64 亿 NCA token 进行预前训练，在使用 Chinchilla 最优数据预算训练的 4 亿至 30 亿参数模型中，可将下游语言建模性能提升最高 6%，并将收敛速度加快最高 1.6 倍。令人惊讶的是，这甚至优于使用 16 亿 token（自然语言文本）进行的预前训练。
tldr: 该论文提出用神经元胞自动机生成非语言的合成数据对大语言模型进行预前训练，仅 1.64 亿 token 即可将下游语言建模性能提升最高 6% 并使收敛加速最高 1.6 倍，表明自然语言并非通向智能的唯一途径。
en_tdlr: Pre-pre-training LLMs on just 164M synthetic tokens generated by neural cellular automata improves downstream language modeling by up to 6% and accelerates convergence by up to 1.6x, showing that natural language is not the only path to intelligence.
